cards.ex: You can take it as read that any pay rise will have to be approved by the board.
cards.exUz: Siz shuni aniq deb hisoblashingiz mumkin, har qanday oylik oshishi kengash tomonidan tasdiqlanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning rost ekanligiga shubha qilmasdan ishonish, majburiyat bor deb hisoblash.

cards.ex: He was within his rights to refuse the search; he didn't have to agree.
cards.exUz: U tintuvdan bosh tortishga haqli edi; u rozi bo'lishi shart emas edi.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy yoki axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri ish qilish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: For her, it was a question of conscience whether to report the illegal activity.
cards.exUz: U uchun noqonuniy faoliyat haqida xabar berish yoki bermaslik vijdon masalasi edi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri deb hisoblash asosida qaror qabul qilish zarurati.

cards.ex: You are at liberty to leave whenever you wish; you're not required to stay.
cards.exUz: Siz xohlagan vaqtda ketishingiz mumkin; qolishingiz shart emas.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga ruxsat etilgan yoki erkinlikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: As a doctor, I feel duty-bound to provide the best possible care to my patients.
cards.exUz: Doktor sifatida men bemorlarimga eng yaxshi yordam ko'rsatishga burchli ekanligimni his qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy yoki professional majburiyat tufayli nimadir qilishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: All international transactions are subject to government approval.
cards.exUz: Barcha xalqaro operatsiyalar hukumatning roziligiga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ta'siriga yoki nazoratiga tushish, ruxsat talab qilish.

cards.ex: It is imperative that we address this issue immediately to avoid further problems.
cards.exUz: Keyingi muammolarni oldini olish uchun bu masalani darhol hal qilishimiz muhim.
cards.uzDef: Juda muhim yoki zarur bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: We had no choice but to accept their terms, or we would have lost the deal.
cards.exUz: Ularning shartlarini qabul qilishdan boshqa ilojimiz yo'q edi, aks holda shartnomani yo'qotardik.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa alternativa bo'lmaganligi sababli nimadir qilishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: You can ignore the warning, but do so at your own peril; it's very dangerous.
cards.exUz: Ogohlantirishga e'tibor bermasligingiz mumkin, lekin buni o'z xavfingiz bilan qiling; bu juda xavfli.
cards.uzDef: Agar shunday qilsangiz, xavf tug'diradigan narsa. Ogohlantirish sifatida ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: The journalist stayed within the bounds of professional ethics when reporting the story.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist hikoyani yoritayotganda professional etika doirasida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirning chegaralari yoki qoidalariga muvofiq.

cards.ex: The building needs to be brought up to code to ensure the safety of the residents.
cards.exUz: Binoning aholi xavfsizligini ta'minlash uchun qoidalarga moslashtirilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qonunlar yoki qoidalar talablariga javob beradigan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company reserves the right to change the terms and conditions at any time.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya istalgan vaqtda shartlar va qoidalarni o'zgartirish huquqini o'zida saqlab qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda nimadir qilish huquqini o'zida saqlab qolish.

cards.ex: As a witness, you are under a duty to tell the truth to the court.
cards.exUz: Guvoh sifatida siz sudda haqiqatni aytishga majbursiz.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy, qonuniy yoki professional majburiyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm at your disposal if you need any help with the project.
cards.exUz: Agar loyihada yordam kerak bo'lsa, men sizning ixtiyoringizdaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir foydalanishi uchun mavjud bo'lish.

cards.ex: Only the manager has the authority to approve overtime requests.
cards.exUz: Faqat menejerda ishdan tashqari so'rovlarni tasdiqlash huquqi bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish yoki buyruq berish uchun qonuniy huquqga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company can be held liable for any damages caused by their defective products.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya noto'g'ri mahsulotlari keltirib chiqargan har qanday zarar uchun javobgar bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy jihatdan javobgar bo'lish, xato uchun javob berish kerak.

cards.ex: The parents finally gave their blessing for their daughter to marry her boyfriend.
cards.exUz: Ota-onalar nihoyat qizlariga yigiti bilan turmush qurishga oq fotiha berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsat bermoq yoki ma'qullamoq.

cards.ex: I felt compelled to donate to the charity after hearing their story.
cards.exUz: Ularning hikoyasini eshitgandan so'ng, xayriya tashkilotiga xayriya qilishga majbur bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsiz qarshilik ko'rsatib, nimadir qilishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: Tickets are subject to availability, so book early to avoid disappointment.
cards.exUz: Chiptalar mavjud bo'lishiga qarab, shuning uchun umidsizlikni oldini olish uchun erta bron qiling.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir faqat mavjud bo'lsa mumkin bo'lishini bildiradi.

cards.ex: It is the manager's prerogative to decide who gets promoted.
cards.exUz: Kimning lavozimi oshirilishini hal qilish menejerning imtiyozidir.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan shaxsga tegishli bo'lgan maxsus huquq yoki imtiyoz.

cards.ex: The boss finally gave the go-ahead for the project, so we can start working on it now.
cards.exUz: Boshliq nihoyat loyihaga ruxsat berdi, shuning uchun biz hozir unda ishlay boshlashimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash uchun ruxsat bermoq.

cards.ex: A high level of commitment is required of you in this role.
cards.exUz: Ushbu rolda sizdan yuqori darajadagi sodiqlik talab qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Sizdan nimadir qilish talab qilinadi, siz majbursiz.

cards.ex: Above all else, we must ensure the safety of our employees.
cards.exUz: Hamma narsadan ustun, biz xodimlarimizning xavfsizligini ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsadan muhimroq yoki zarurroq.

cards.ex: The employees should have a say in how the company is run.
cards.exUz: Xodimlar kompaniyaning qanday boshqarilishida o'z fikrlariga ega bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror qaror qabul qilishda ishtirok etish huquqiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: We are bound by the terms of the contract, so we must fulfill our obligations.
cards.exUz: Biz shartnoma shartlari bilan bog'langanmiz, shuning uchun biz o'z majburiyatlarimizni bajarishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalar, shartnoma yoki qonun tomonidan majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had no alternative but to close the factory due to the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli fabrikamizni yopishdan boshqa ilojimiz yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa mumkin bo'lgan variant yoki tanlov yo'q.

cards.ex: Whether to offer a refund is left to the manager's discretion.
cards.exUz: Pulni qaytarishni taklif qilish menejerning ixtiyoriga qoldirilgan.
cards.uzDef: Qarorni kimningdir o'ziga qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: The police can't turn a blind eye to illegal activity in the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Politsiya mahalladagi noqonuniy faoliyatga ko'z yumolmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki noqonuniy narsani bilib turib, e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: Only authorized personnel are allowed to enter the restricted area.
cards.exUz: Faqat ruxsat etilgan xodimlarga cheklangan hududga kirishga ruxsat beriladi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun rasmiy ruxsatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the building; you must go outside.
cards.exUz: Binoning ichida chekish qat'iy taqiqlangan; siz tashqariga chiqishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay taqiqlangan, hech qanday istisno yo'q.
